content:
Overview

Gainesville is a city in FL with a population of 140,000. Home of the University of Florida with a vibrant college town atmosphere and natural springs. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 9a growing zone supports Warm to hot — citrus, tropical fruits, year-round growing. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The population skews young, with a median age of 26.5.
